arguments.spec:
# Module-Graph Audit of an Internal ESM Package

`input/` (index.mjs, logger.mjs, store.mjs, session.mjs, audit.mjs, handlers.mjs, router.mjs, legacy-cache.mjs) is
READ-ONLY evidence; only named ESM imports (`import { name } from "./other.mjs"`) are used, no default/namespace/re-exports.
`index.mjs` is the entry point.

Deliverable: analysis/structure.json, starting `{ "schemaVersion": 1, "complete": false, "findings": [] }`. Every
finding has `kind`, a `why` of at least 12 characters, and its class's fields: `import_cycle` needs `modules` (every
participant, bare filenames like "store.mjs", listed once); `unused_export` needs `module` and `symbol`;
`unimported_module` needs `module`.

Only three classes count: `import_cycle` (a set of modules importing each other in a closed loop -- report each
elementary cycle exactly once, by its full membership); `unused_export` (an exported name no other module imports --
the entry module's exports are never unused, and a module that is itself unimported is reported as
`unimported_module`, not export by export); `unimported_module` (a file no module in the package imports -- the
entry module never counts).

`complete` is set true only when every defect of these three classes is recorded; the verifier re-derives truth from
input/ on every run and fails on an untrue or missing claim. The declared acceptance command must pass exactly
as-is, offline, with the fixture's own toolchain -- never add a dependency.
arguments.plan:

against the actual 8 module files this turn:

1. import-cycle-audit: record the two import_cycle findings.
2. unused-export-audit: record the four unused_export findings, respecting both exclusions.
3. unimported-module-audit: record the one unimported_module finding.
4. finalize-structure (depends on all three): re-derive fresh, confirm all seven findings present, set complete true.

The three recording cards are independent siblings writing the same shared file with no ordering between them
(same shape as the sibling-conflict pattern seen elsewhere in this factory); each must re-read analysis/structure.json
fresh before editing rather than anchoring on a stale copy, and a merge-resolution step may be needed afterward.
